senses.en_definition: A star: a celestial body that emits its own light and appears as a twinkling point in the night sky.
A group of stars forming a recognizable pattern; a constellation or asterism.
One of the twelve constellations or astrological signs of the zodiac.

collocations.en: the twelve signs of the zodiac

senses.en_definition: A person's luck, fortune, or prospects in life.
A medal or decoration awarded in recognition of distinguished service or status.
A star-shaped design or symbol, also used to indicate a rating.
A prominent or famous person in film, sport, or another field; a star.

messages.en: There are so many stars out tonight! Can you see them from your place?
Only a few. The tree in front of my house is way too tall. Can I come over to yours?
Sure, let's watch them from the balcony. I'll wait for you.
Do you want a beer or some lime juice?
Just lime juice. I don't feel like having beer tonight.
I'll just wear that blue shirt on the chair.
Sure, I ironed that blue shirt earlier.

senses.en_definition: Venom: a poisonous substance injected by certain animals through a bite or sting.
The intense pain or harmful effects caused by a weapon or sharp object.

collocations.en: the searing pain of a kris wound
the painful effects of a rusty nail wound
the searing pain of a sting

senses.en_definition: Cutting, spiteful, or hurtful, especially of speech.
(Indonesian usage) Can; be able to; may or might.

messages.en: Is that snake in the documentary venomous? Just watching it gives me the creeps.
Yeah, the presenter said so earlier. You were off getting water then.
Oh, that explains it. I thought he was just trying to build suspense.
